rows.answer: The annual family/parents/guardians income ceiling from all sources for a student to be eligible under the Top Class Education scheme is Rs. 8,00,000 (eight lakhs) per annum [S1, S2, S3].

Under the Top Class Education scheme, a student receives an academic allowance of Rs. 86,000 in the first year of study [S1]. This allowance is provided to take care of living expenses, books and stationery, and a computer/laptop of a reputed brand with accessories like a UPS and printer [S1].
Yes, there is a ceiling on the tuition fee and non-refundable charges paid for a student at a private sector institution, which is set at Rs. 2.00 lakh per annum per student [S1].

Based on the provided excerpts, a Top Class Education scholarship is terminated or discontinued in the following circumstances:

* The student fails to get promoted to the next semester/class (though the scholarship will be released suo moto once the student gets promoted) [S1].
* The student changes his/her institute/college after getting selected under the scheme [S1].
Thirty percent (30%) of the scholarship slots allotted to an institution are reserved for eligible Scheduled Caste girl students [S1, S2].
A person needs to have not less than forty percent of a specified disability to be treated as a person with benchmark disability [S1].

The annual parental/guardian's income limit for both the Pre-matric and Post-matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities is that income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/- (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand only) per annum [S1].
The monthly special allowance for reader, escort, or helper support for a student with disabilities under the Top Class Education scholarship is Rs. 2,000/- per month [S1].
The annual allowance for books and stationery for a student under the Top Class Education scholarship is Rs. 5,000/- per annum [S1].

Yes, the schemes include a component that pays for coaching [S1, S2, S3]. Yes, there is the National Overseas Scholarship scheme for studying for a Master's Degree or Ph.D. in Institutions, Colleges, or Universities abroad [S1, S2].
